scenario.name: 10-stripe-test-mode
scenario.description: Real Stripe test mode behind the fault proxy (requires STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_...). 300 rows, open loop at 5 tx/s to stay well under test-mode rate limits; 5% of responses are dropped after Stripe has executed the request.

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Homebrew) on aarch64-apple-darwin25.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), 64-bit

checks.name: journal_entries_balanced
checks.detail: every journal entry's postings sum to zero and it has >= 2 postings

checks.name: account_balances_match_postings
checks.detail: cached account balance equals the sum of its postings

checks.name: ledger_sums_to_zero_per_currency
checks.detail: sum of all balances is zero in every currency

checks.name: posting_currency_matches_account
checks.detail: postings only touch accounts in the journal's currency

checks.name: succeeded_payments_have_one_capture
checks.detail: each succeeded payment has exactly one capture entry debiting clearing by its amount

checks.name: no_capture_without_success
checks.detail: no capture entry exists for a payment that is not succeeded

checks.name: succeeded_refunds_have_one_entry
checks.detail: each succeeded refund has exactly one refund entry; others have none

checks.name: refund_reservations_consistent
checks.detail: payments.amount_refunded equals succeeded + in-flight refunds

checks.name: fees_within_amount
checks.detail: fee is set exactly for succeeded payments and 0 <= fee <= amount

checks.name: terminal_events_recorded
checks.detail: each succeeded/failed payment has its outbox event
